about.title: How to play
about.intro: Every day brings one monster per quest. Pick it from the search box; each wrong guess gives you more to go on. There's no limit on guesses. A new set of monsters arrives at midnight, your local time.
about.classicText: Each guess adds a row comparing your monster with the answer. Green is a match, orange a partial match (some shared values, or an overlapping threat range), red no match. Arrows show whether the answer's size, threat level or generation is higher or lower.
about.compendiumText: Read a field-guide entry with the name hidden. After 5 wrong guesses you can open the monster's class, after 10 one of its nicknames.
about.surveyorText: The picture starts as a dark blur. Every wrong guess makes it sharper and brighter.
about.roarText: Play the monster's cry. The class and nickname hints unlock after 5 and 10 wrong guesses.
about.extraText: After clearing a daily quest you can keep playing with random monsters in infinite mode. Clear every quest on a day to grow your streak; miss a day and it resets. Share your result with a link that carries your game selection, so friends get the same monster and see your score to beat.
about.dataText: Monster attributes come from the Monster Hunter Wiki on Fandom, used under CC BY-SA 3.0. Descriptions and Arabic text were written for this project. Sizes are gold-crown sizes in centimetres; threat levels are the star ratings shown in-game, where the wiki records them. Missing values are shown as “?”.
about.privacyText: Everything is stored only in your browser (local storage). There are no accounts, cookies, ads or trackers.
